## Quick Actions

```bash
# Generate fresh report
make telemetry-report PERIOD=weekly

# Export data for analysis
make telemetry-export FORMAT=json OUTPUT=telemetry_export.json

# Validate data integrity
make telemetry-validate

# Query specific events
python3 .agents/scripts/agents-telemetry.py query --event-type=session_end --limit=10
```

---

## Refresh Dashboard

To update this dashboard with latest data:

```bash
# Generate report and update dashboard
python3 .agents/scripts/agents-telemetry.py report --period=weekly --format=json > .agents/a-docs/telemetry/reports/latest.json
```
